lines.en: I drag my robe across the wet sand.
Green liquid drips from my sleeve.
I walk the tide line for ingredients.
My boots crush shells.
My vials clink as I walk.

lines.zh: 我低头看脚下，不敢走快。
lines.en: I watch my feet and don't hurry.
Seaweed clings to my hem.
I skirt puddles so the doses stay dry.

lines.zh: 我在沙上留下一串脚印。
lines.en: I leave a line of prints in the sand.

lines.zh: 远处的礁石，我记在心里。
lines.en: I note the reef in the distance.
I stop and pour out a little.
My breath smells sour.
I brace a hand on my knee for this stretch.

lines.zh: 我把袍子提起来过了水。
lines.en: I lift my robe to cross the water.
I hold a vial up to my eye.
What's inside turns slowly.
I lick a finger and frown.
I count how many vials remain.
I crouch and draw a circle in the sand.

lines.zh: 岸边的风把我的帽檐吹起。
lines.en: The shore wind lifts my hood.
I recite the formula once.

lines.zh: 有个声音在附近，我停手。
lines.en: A sound nearby; I stop working.
I roll my sleeves to the elbow.
The bitterness lingers.

lines.zh: 我的指甲缝里全是药渣。
lines.en: My nails are packed with reagent residue.
I shake the vial; the colour changes.
I tuck the vial back inside my coat.
I stare at the sea and say nothing.

lines.zh: 你的手很干净，没碰过药。
lines.en: Your hands are clean — you have never handled reagents.
I raise my eyes briefly.
Are you buying, or leaving?
Don't touch what I'm holding.
You are blocking my path to the herbs.

lines.zh: 我往前半步，袍子挡住了你。
lines.en: Half a step and my robe blocks you.
This formula would not agree with you.

lines.zh: 我评估了一下你的体格。
lines.en: I size up your build.
Do you want to live longer?
Your hands are unhurt.
I tilt my head and smile.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，正好闻得到药。
lines.en: Where you stand, you can smell the fumes.
I gasp and cover my ribs.
Some of the dose spilled; a waste.
I retreat, hand still raised.
That reached the bone.
I cough once; the fumes sting.
Blood on sand stands out.
I pull my robe tighter.

lines.zh: 你的力气不像是这体型。
lines.en: Your strength doesn't match your size.
I press my ribs; blood seeps between my fingers.
I'll return this in kind.
Smell of kelp.
This can go into a formula.
Let me see that bottle you hold.
I'll name a price; don't be offended.
Very fresh; good material.
I bring it to my nose.
For this quality, I will pay well.
Where did you get it?
Patience; let me test it.
It smells of fish; excellent.
You knock into my case.
I cover the vials at my chest.
Don't push; these are fragile.
I catch myself on the reef rock.
You're standing on my robe.
We collide and sand flies.
I step back and check the vials.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，撞翻了我的药。
lines.en: That shove knocked over my reagents.
This case is tougher than I am.
Move; I need to get past.

lines.zh: 这个配方我一个人配不完。
lines.en: I can't finish this formula alone.

lines.zh: 她也在研究同一样东西。
lines.en: She studies the same thing I do.
We compared our notes.
Her laugh sounds like a bubble popping.
We split the last half vial.
She stood between me and the wind.
We agreed to test it together.
Her hands are steadier than mine.
We sit side by side on the rock.
She drinks first; then I do.
I pick up a scale.
This is decent quality.
I put it in a small pouch.
Whose bottle is that on the ground?
It's bitter; usable.

lines.zh: 我把上面的盐擦掉，收好。
lines.en: I wipe the salt off and put it away.
This stone is full of salt.
I sniff and shake my head.
I tuck it into a hidden layer of my case.
I recognize this.
That snow golem is perfect.
I raise my hand; my fingertips glow.
I've got the angle.
It moves; I need to root it.

lines.zh: 瓶子在我手心里热起来。
lines.en: The vial warms in my palm.
I murmur a word under my breath.
Not far at all.
I step back and brace.
Formula's sound; beginning.
The bottle mouth lines up with its knee.
My palm starts to sweat.
It has its back to my bottle.
I lift the vial.
Just one hit will do.
I track along the reef.
It turns; so do I.
I draw a ring in the sand.
I count the blocks between.
The dose grows hot in my hand.
I shrink into a crevice and wait for you to come closer.
Its footsteps are heavy; easy to hear.
A little closer is enough.
I pull the stopper.
The wind is blowing toward me.
Holding my breath, I listen for its steps.

lines.zh: 我把退路算进了配方里。
lines.en: I have factored its retreat into the formula.
It stepped where I wanted.
The instant it turns its head — that is enough.

lines.zh: 我把药泼出去，白烟起来。
lines.en: I fling the dose; white smoke rises.
One of its legs stiffens.
I use the moment to back away.
Glass breaks on the ground.

lines.zh: 我的手被自己的药烧到。
lines.en: My own mixture burns my hand.
It stays upright anyway.
I add another vial.
I can't see through the smoke.
It starts to shake.
A dirty trick, but it works.
I cough.
I move upwind.
It goes down, slowly.
I wipe the mixture off my hand.
The tide goes out and leaves me.
I step out from behind the reef.
My vials clink first.
A new line of prints on the sand.
The salt wind knocks my hood askew.
I crouch and touch the sand.

lines.zh: 沙上有脚印，不是我留的。
lines.en: There are prints in the sand, and they are not mine.
I set my case down firmly.

lines.zh: 空气里有股酸味，是我的。
lines.en: There's a sour smell; that's mine.
The tide is out; time to get to work.

lines.zh: 这里的东西，都还没采过。
lines.en: Nothing here has been harvested yet.
I let out a breath.
This place is cleaner than I expected.
I crouch at the tide line.

lines.zh: 火烧到我的袖口，药味变焦。
lines.en: Fire catches my sleeve; the smell turns acrid.

lines.zh: 我落地时扭了脚，瓶子全响。
lines.en: I twist my ankle landing; every vial rings.

lines.zh: 咸水灌进喉咙，我呛得厉害。
lines.en: Salt water floods my throat; I choke.

lines.zh: 爆风把我的药箱掀翻了。
lines.en: The blast flips my case open.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过了我的袍子。
lines.en: An arrow passes through my robe.

lines.zh: 对方的术法缠住我的手指。
lines.en: Their spell knots around my fingers.
Hunger makes my hands shake.

lines.zh: 雷击下来，我手里的瓶子炸了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; the vial in my hand bursts.
No sand, no sea, only black.
